title: An Array Specification Gives a List Specification
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, $a,N,\mathrm{top}\in\mathbb{N}$, $l$ be a list of integers, and $U\in\mathbb{Z}$. If $l$ has length $N$, its $j$th entry is $\mu(a+j)$ for every $j<N$, every entry has absolute value at most $U$, and $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$, then $l$ has length $N$, records those values of $\mu$, and satisfies $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$.
hypotheses_covered: The array conditions: length N, segment values, absolute bound U, and a+N≤top
